summary: First testing pass on NexMart (frontend-only mock app). Verified 18 core flows across Landing/Architecture/Auth and full Customer, Vendor, and Admin modules. All critical user journeys and data-testid selectors work as specified. No backend (as expected — mock-only app). One transient failure in an initial script was traced to invalid test-input overwrite, not an app bug; on retry with prefilled defaults, place-order->success->tracking flow works end-to-end (order NM96020 created, timeline rendered with Placed active, Cancel order button visible).

issues: Minor: React Router v7 future-flag warnings in console (non-blocking, cosmetic)

critical_code_review_comments: Consider opting into React Router v7 future flags (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) to silence noisy console warnings on every route change.
Checkout inputs are prefilled with valid Indian defaults which is good UX for a demo, but if the user clears the phone field the validation must still block submission — worth manual verification.
test_credentials: None required — used data-testid onetap-customer / onetap-vendor / onetap-admin to enter modules.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary data-testid selectors resolve. Verified: Landing (brand, ticker, stat counters, cta-*, footer-architecture), Architecture, Auth (onetap-*), Customer Home (add-to-cart-* increments cart badge), Nearby, Search+NL (nl-input/nl-run/nl-add-all with 'ingredients for biryani for 6 people'), Cart (cart-item-* grouping by store, bill summary), Checkout (address prefilled, place-order -> /customer/order/success/:id), Order Tracking (5-stage timeline with Placed active + cancel-order button), Vendor Dashboard (KPI+chart+top products+Sentinel brief+low-stock steppers), Vendor Orders (5 columns), Vendor Inventory (inv-search + stock-inc-* works), Sentinel chat (chat-input/chat-send reply), Admin Executive, Admin Simulator (sim-start toggles), Admin Approvals (approve-* buttons render), Admin Stream (stream-pause works), 404 page, cart persistence after reload. IMPORTANT gotcha for future tests: on Checkout do NOT overwrite the address inputs with arbitrary text — they are pre-filled with valid values; just click place-order.
rca of the issue: N/A — no unresolved issues. Initial 'place_order FAIL' was a false negative caused by the test script filling all inputs (including phone) with 'Test Value 12345' which failed the +91 phone regex; retest with the app's prefilled defaults succeeded.
